title: Chapter 1040
text:
"Damn, it even gave me a mission."

Han Xiao glanced at it curiously.

Primal Esper Ability Entities were very strong, but they were nothing to him at the moment.

To paraphrase an anime he had seen in his previous life, the existence of Primal Esper Ability Entities was somewhat similar to that of a tailed beast. In the beginning, it was exaggerated to the skies, as if it was invincible, but in the later stages, in the eyes of those super combat forces that could easily move mountains and fill seas and plant trees … Ha, could this thing even kill people?

Similarly, the host was like a Jinchuriki. If the Primal Esper Ability Entities met a powerful host, they would have a chance to unleash even more power.

Looking at the mission reward, Han Xiaoxin started to calculate.

"From the difficulty of this mission, it requires a large number of Calamity Grade players to form a team. It's a team mission in the later versions, but the EXP reward fits the criteria. Two Character Summon Cards, probably for the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy and the Holy Light Particle. To the players, they basically can't take over the Primal Esper Ability Entities, so the Character Summon Cards are useful. I can subdue them, so the Character Summon Cards are just a bonus to me … Only this special milestone mission seems interesting …"

This was usually a hidden mission. Han Xiao had seen other special milestones in his previous life, but this was the first time he had seen [Primal Esper Ability Collector]. No one had triggered it in his previous life.

"It does sound cool, but I don't know what effect it has. Maybe it's more suitable for Espers?"

Han Xiao stroked his chin, thought for a few seconds, and put this question aside.

No matter what, he was going to push for the Holy Light Particle anyway, mainly to get another Primal Esper Ability Entity. The mission was just a bonus. He would see what this special milestone mission was about when the time came. Right now, he had no clue.

"I promise you this. I'll definitely get the Holy Light Particle to accompany you."

"Then, when do we leave?"

The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy could not wait. It looked like it wanted to take revenge, but based on his experience in his previous life, Han Xiao felt that it could not wait to meet its old flame.

Heh, Esper Ability.

Han Xiao thought for a while, shook his head, and said, "Not now. I still have some things to do. When the time is right, I'll make a move on it."

He had some things to do at the moment. His first task was to create the King and the Emperor's Cape, the two Gold equipment. At the same time, he also had to research a special carrier for the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy and create a mechanical host.

This way, he could have a special mechanical guard with a high-risk Esper Ability. Its grade was not easy to determine, and it depended on the performance of the carrier. If he could turn it into a mechanical life form, with the effect of the Esper Ability, it would definitely be able to display dazzling combat strength.

Of course, there were similar precedents in the Mechanic class. The Beyond Grade As captured by the Mechanic Emperor were used to create special mechanical puppets. Apostle Weapons were a high-level troop type given by the class, and Mechanics could create their own unique high-level troop type.

On the other hand, the information revealed by Secret Master also made Han Xiao even more certain that Hella's situation was dangerous. Therefore, his main body still had to hide in the Emerald Star Cluster and wait for the opportunity to move.

At the same time, players from all over the universe were rushing to the Flickering World, and the situation in the world server was quickly taking shape. According to Han Xiao's understanding of the players, although he was harvesting leeks happily, the army players standing out like cranes in a flock of chickens would also be targeted by the players of other factions. He had to stay here and observe the situation. Due to the existence of the Black Star Corps, the trajectory of the players in the Flickering World was naturally different from his previous life, so he had to adapt to the situation.

Compared to the importance of these things, the issue of the Holy Light Particle had to be put aside for a while. Not to mention, this mission also required him to make a trip to the secondary dimension and find out which secondary dimension the Holy Light Particle was in.

"Alright, I'll wait."

The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy did not mind. It had a long lifespan, so it was not in a hurry. It understood that Black Star's current identity was its master, not a tool like the previous host.

Its only regret was that it would probably be sealed in a lifeless mechanical body, unable to communicate with others, so it was not as interesting as being played by the host.

Sigh, I clearly found a perfect partner not long ago, but it's a pity that I won't be able to fuse with him.

At this time, Han Xiao disconnected the mental connection, put the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy into his pocket, stood up, put away the Divine Mechanical Throne, summoned a spaceship, and returned with Psionic Prime and the others.

…

As the ownership of the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy was settled, all the retreating participants no longer had any intention of keeping it a secret. They quickly released a recording of the scene on the internet, and in just a few hours, it was on the headlines.

"The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy Appears, Falling into Black Star's Hands"!

The changes in the Flickering World now affected the nerves of the entire universe. The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy appeared in the free competition zone and fell into Black Star's hands. This news ignored the distance in reality and quickly spread on the internet of the various Star Fields.

The galactic residents did not know much about Primal Esper Ability Entities, but the 'Super High Risk Esper Ability List' was very famous. Furthermore, there were two popular titles, 'Flickering World' and 'Black Star'. At the same time, there was a recording of the battle in the news. Therefore, it was not surprising that the news was so popular. It quickly became the topic of conversation for countless galactic residents.

A few hours after the news was released, the production company of Wayne Cards announced that they would be creating a new card for the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy, possibly joining the Black Star Corps Faction Card Deck. They were also considering releasing the 'Primal Esper Ability Entities' series of cards in the future.

The players who liked to surf the internet also saw this news. While being surprised, they also remembered the new concept of 'Primal Esper Ability Entities'.

However, the news this time was mainly focused on the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy. Black Star had done too many shocking things. Compared to the big events in the past, this was not as big of a deal. Therefore, countless galactic residents and players were used to it.

They already knew that Black Star was amazing. This is just a basic operation. Sit down.

…

In a secret military base of the dynasty in the Central Galaxy.

One of the internal bars was packed with people. It was very noisy, filled with loud shouts and laughter, as well as the sound of people gulping down alcohol. The atmosphere was very lively. The guests present were all warriors and officers wearing the dynasty's uniform.

This military base was mainly used as a training ground. A large number of people from the dynasty were trained here. Because it was a half-closed base, there were internal entertainment venues, mainly bars. In the current era, the civilizations were not too harsh on the Super soldiers. The treatment and benefits were very good. Even in closed training, they had a certain degree of freedom to enjoy life.

A few Super key training camps were also training here. They were all members who were on the dynasty's key training list. Gaud was one of them. He was also training in this base.

At this moment, a row of key trainees were sitting at the bar counter. They were all Calamity Grades. They were drinking and chatting with each other.

Gaud was among them. He raised his glass with a calm smile on his face and occasionally added a few words. He looked like he was quite popular, and the atmosphere was very harmonious.

He was the most valued one among all the trainees. The Esper Ability he had had a bright future, so he had always been a popular person in the training camp.

One of them shook his head and said with a smile, "Among us, the one who is most likely to break through the Beyond Grade A boundary is you, Gaud. There's really no comparison. We might all become your subordinates in the future and need you to take care of us."

"Speaking of which, if you become a Beyond Grade A, what position do you plan to take? I don't think you'll be part of the Ruler's bodyguard. I don't think the Empire will send you out, so they'll probably let you be the commander of some army so you can quickly rise to the upper echelons of the military, "another person said.

"I don't care." Gaud smiled. He was a direct Beyond Grade A of the dynasty, so his development direction was naturally different from his allies. He could step into the core of the dynasty's power just like the Dark Emperor.

"According to the past, we might be assigned to your army in the future … Tsk, we might as well take turns toasting to our future commander. If we don't get you drunk today, don't even think about leaving." Someone laughed loudly.

Gaud smiled and dealt with the enthusiasm of his colleagues.

Just as the atmosphere was getting heated, Gaud suddenly saw the news playing on the virtual screen on the wall of the bar. His expression froze, and his smile quickly disappeared.

His abnormal reaction stunned his colleagues. They followed his gaze and saw that the virtual screen was playing the news about the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy being taken away by Black Star.

"Yo, Black Star is doing something new again."

"Impressive, as expected of the next generation leader appointed by the dynasty."

"A few years ago, when I was baptized by the Evolution Cube, I saw him up close and almost couldn't help but ask for his autograph."

"Luckily, he's an ally of our dynasty and didn't get taken away by Radiance and Ethereal. This is the dynasty's blessing."

They could not help but talk about this topic. Everyone there was a Calamity Grade who respected the strong. Many of them were fans of the dynasty's Beyond Grade A allies, and quite a few of them were fans of Black Star.

At this time, Gaud put down his glass, stood up expressionlessly, and said, "I have something to do. I'll take my leave first."

After saying that, he didn't wait for the crowd to react. He walked straight through the crowd and left the bar, leaving many of his colleagues in the same place. They looked at each other in confusion.

What's going on? What's wrong?

On the other side, Gaud left the bar, quickly returned to his room, took out his communicator, and contacted Bekorodi.

It rang for a while before the other side picked up. Gaud immediately took the initiative.

"You told me to wait for good news, and this is your so-called good news?"

Bekorodi was silent for a few seconds before slowly replying, "Black Star's intervention was unexpected. The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy is indeed in his hands now."

"Then, what do you plan to do?" Gaud was expressionless.

"I'll try to salvage the situation and see if I can exchange for the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy from Black Star."

"…"

Gaud was silent. He did not ask what he would do if he could not exchange for it.

The dynasty was willing to give him the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy because they wanted him to make full use of his Esper Ability and enter the Beyond Grade A realm as soon as possible so that he could analyze the theory of evolution energy for the dynasty. Without the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy, the dynasty could wait for him to grow slowly.

However, to Gaud, this meant that he had lost a major source of combat power. Without the various special abilities of the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy, it severely disrupted the growth plan he had set for himself. He would not be able to reach the strongest state he had imagined.

This meant that the upper limit of his future combat power was directly cut off!

"Black Star can't use the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy himself, so as long as we have enough bargaining chips, he'll still exchange for it. It's not like there's no chance. I …"

Bekorodi was still analyzing the situation when Gaud interrupted him.

"That's all for now. Let me know if there's any progress."

Then, Gaud hung up and frowned.

He was in a very bad mood. He did not want to pretend to be nice to Bekorodi. He knew very well that the chances of getting the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy back were slim.

The dynasty would not pay a high price for a dispensable Primal Esper Ability Entity, and Black Star was a b * stard who would never make a loss. With his understanding of both parties, the chances of a deal being made were close to zero.

Gaud shook his head and crossed out the name of the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy in his mind.

With his current strength, he was not qualified to participate in the battle for the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy at all. The only way was to borrow the dynasty's strength. Since the dynasty had failed, there was nothing he could do about it.

He had not grown up yet, and Black Star's force was getting bigger and bigger. If the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy was gone, so be it. Now was far from the time to mess with Black Star.

"I thought that with the dynasty's help, this thing would be in the bag. I didn't expect you to cut me off. Now, I have no choice but to change my growth plan … Tsk, Black Star, oh Black Star, you really know how to give me trouble."

Gaud was in a very bad mood.

…

Emerald Star Cluster, Modo Civilization base …

In front of the remote communication room connected to the Modo Civilization's mother planet, two guards were whispering to each other.

"How long have the commander and inspector been in there?"

"Almost an hour."

"Seems like His Excellency Three Kings summoned them. I wonder when they'll come out …"

"Hey, the door's open, the door's open. Quick, stand still."

The door of the room slid open. The two guards hurriedly stood up straight, stopped talking, and looked straight ahead like they were not slacking off. However, they could not help but glance at Commander Roddick and Inspector Lagos from the corner of their eyes.

Roddick's face was green, and his face was extremely dark like he was about to explode. Lagos, on the other hand, had his head lowered and looked listless.

Due to the pointless sacrifice of dozens of Calamity Grade elites, Roddick was scolded by the Modo Three Kings and even scolded by his direct superior. Among the upper echelons, his impression was at rock bottom.

Although he was only carrying out the mission given to him by his superiors, and the loss of dozens of Calamity Grades was not his fault, he could only take the blame. He was so angry that he was about to explode.

Lagos could not comfort him. He hesitated and asked, "Our upper echelons have suffered heavy losses. His Excellency Three Kings also said that similar things are not allowed to happen again. What do you plan to do?"

"It's all because of Black Star!" Roddick clenched his fists and said angrily, "If we continue to be passive like this, Black Star will still be able to eat away at our strength. If we don't solve this problem completely, similar things will happen again."

If we could stop Black Star, we would have done it a long time ago.

Lagos smiled bitterly and could only ask, "Then, what do you think?"

"If we can kill Black Star …"

Riddick muttered to himself. When he turned his head, he saw Lagos's expression that said, "I'm afraid you're not awake yet." He swallowed the rest of his words, thought for a moment, and changed his words.

After thinking for a while, he said, "It's impossible for us to become enemies with Black Star by ourselves. We can only rely on external forces … If we give the Black Star Corps a huge problem and make him have no time to care about us, we might be able to alleviate the situation."

"For example?"

Hearing this, Roddick opened his mouth and felt bitter.

If it was so easy to think of this, how could he have ended up in such a state? If he did not make any contributions, he would probably have no hope of being promoted in the future.
